extension.summary: Movies, HD movies and TV shows from filmifen.com
extension.description: Fork of plugin.video.filmifen 2026.05.05.01 by MartinStZ (GPL-3.0). Rebuilt for the current filmifen.com markup: working Movies, Movies HD and TV Shows listings, working search and pagination. The resolver hand-off (script.module.findstreamurl) is kept identical to the reference add-on.
extension.disclaimer: Some parts of this add-on may not be legal in your country of residence - check your local laws before installing. This add-on does not host or distribute any content.
extension.news: First release of the fork. TV Shows listing fixed (series cards have no category element), pagination fixed (relative links absolutized, search list_submit handled), search fixed for series results, menu reduced to Search, Movies, Movies HD, TV Shows.
